### Elden Ring Nightreign Fulghor Maris Fathom of Night Everdark Sovereign (Augur) Boss Guide

#### Maris Fathom of Night Everdark Sovereign (Augur) Fight Strategy

The **Everdark Sovereign** variant of **Maris** will have significant changes compared to the regular encounter (see Maris Fathom of Night), increasing the difficulty of the boss.

Similar to the **Everdark Sovereign** variants of other [bosses](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses"), such as [Fulghor](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fulghor_Champion_of_Nightglow_Everdark_Sovereign_(darkdrift_Knight) "Fulghor Champion of Nightglow Everdark Sovereign (darkdrift Knight)"), the fight with **Maris** is expected to start during the second phase of the fight, wherein **Augur** will launch more aggressive attacks. Additionally, **Everdark Sovereign Maris** will be summoning more jellyfish in the arena, making it difficult for players to navigate around as they chase the flying **Augur** around the battlefield.

**Everdark Sovereign Maris** will still have the same weakness as its regular variant, which is [![lightning upgrade affinity elden ring wiki guide 60px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/5/57/Lightning-icon-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide.png/20px-Lightning-icon-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Lightning_Damage "Lightning Damage") [Lightning](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Lightning_Damage "Lightning Damage"). Players are recommended to plan routes that will yield Lightning [weapons](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Weapons "Weapons"), which will be of significant help for staggering **Everdark Sovereign Maris** whenever it starts channeling the **Hypnosis** attack.

After completing the 1st phase of the fight, **Maris Fathom of the Night** will drop a legendary **Storm Ruler.** From Software veterans will recognize this as a long line of flying bosses that have appeared in games such as Demon's Souls. Here are some tips and important mechanics Storm Ruler:

- Each player gets one - and you should use it. The **Storm Ruler** skill from the weapon is key to this fight.
- When you hold the skill, not attacking, just in the stance - **YOU REGAIN FP.** This is crucial since many players are reporting that they run out of FP during the fight, or believe that they have to play heavy-FP [Classes](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Classes "Classes") like [Recluse](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Recluse "Recluse") or [Revenant](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Revenant "Revenant")
- On the other hand, when you hold the skill without attacking for several seconds, you charge up a much stronger and larger attack. It creates a MASSIVE vertical attack.

**DON'T** spam the weapon art immediately, it will drain your FP in a few seconds.

The first phase against **Augur** is pretty straightforward and does not pose much of a challenge. It can be defeated quite easily if you know what you are doing. This first phase ends once players have depleted Maris Fathom of the Night first health bar. As it dies, it will leave a legendary weapon that, as previously mentioned, is **VERY IMPORTANT** for this fight. Note that all players will be able to loot this legendary weapon.

After a few short seconds, **Maris, Fathom of the Night** will emerge from the skies and enter the battlefield. In a way, it is a similar fight that the Elden Beast in base Elden Ring. Maris will fly across the sky and meteors will shoot from its body to the ground.

You will have to strike a balance in order to fight it using the legendary weapon, while also dodging the projectiles since attacking leaves you stuck to the ground for a few seconds. (specially if you fully charge the attack). Try to be on the move while you are not attacking in order to dodge incoming attacks.

As you remove almost half its health, Maris will enter its third phase, becoming an even bigger being, and meteors will float around its "Head" during the rest of the fight. During this phase it will also become more nimble, and agile, reaching higher speeds than in the previous ones.

Try to shoot the collar of meteors floating around it. You can lock onto each of them and use the legendary weapon art to destroy them. This meteor collar, allows Maris to shoot multiple targets at the same time, so dealing damage to them as fast as possible should be priority.

Once all of them are destroyed, Maris will fall down to the ground, stunned. Land as many hits as possible during this time.

Try to focus on the meteors ASAP to avoid multiple attacks. and repeat this process until **Maris Fathom of Night** is down. This fight is about endurance and can become quite long given the boss flying around the whole battlefield.

| **Great Hypnosis** | **Maris** flies off and curls up in the air, causing **S**l**eep** buildup just like its normal variant, but the huildup is much faster. | Players should attack with **Storm Ruler** to try and stop **Maris** from continuing its spell any further. |

The explosions, however, travel very fast, so players should dodge as soon as they see them. |

This attack is often used in combination with its **Ignition Laser**. | There is an audio cue that lets players know the lasers are about to be fired. # Libra Creature of Night

'*Libra, Creature of Night**, also known as** Equilibrious Beast**, is a** [Nightlord Boss](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses") **in** [Nightreign](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Nightreign_Wiki "Elden Ring Nightreign Wiki")**. Encountered at the end of the [Equilibrious Beast](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Equilibrious_Beast "Equilibrious Beast") expedition,** Libra **is fought on the third and final day. This** Libra, Creature of Night **boss guide covers** Libra''***s** attacks, weaknesses, rewards, and strategies for defeating this Nightlord.

- [Click here for the Everdark Sovereign variant of Libra Creature of Night](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Libra_Creature_of_Night_Everdark_Sovereign_(equilibrious_Beast) "Libra Creature of Night Everdark Sovereign (equilibrious Beast)")

> A goat-headed being who pretends to be a man, said to be able to use a dubious form of alchemy. Counterfeit gold causes loss of sanity, beckoning madness. However, those who foment madness are sure to succumb to the selfsame malady in the end.

### Elden Ring Nightreign Libra, Creature of Night Boss

- This is the nightlord encountered during the [Equilibrious Beast](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Equilibrious_Beast "Equilibrious Beast") expedition
- Before the fight with **Libra**, players must interact with the [Scale-bearing Merchant](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Scale-bearing_Merchant "Scale-bearing Merchant"). This merchant can provide players with a random pool of buffs in exchange for a negative effect. Players may either take a deal or refuse it, and then the merchant will turn into **Libra**. Listed below are some of the possible choices that the **Scale-bearing Merchant** can give players:

-   - *I wish to have great strength* - Raises [Strength](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Strength "Strength") in exchange for all other stats
  - *I wish to have great dexterity* - Raises [Dexterity](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Dexterity "Dexterity") in exchange for all other stats
  - *I wish to expand my intellect* - Raises [Intelligence](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Intelligence "Intelligence") in exchange for all other stats
  - *I wish to have deep faith* - Raises [Faith](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Faith "Faith") in exchange for all other stats
  - *I wish to be in touch with the arcane* - Raises [Arcane](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Arcane "Arcane") in exchange for all other stats
  - *I want resistance to ailments* - Increases Resistances by +150, but lose 10% Stamina
  - *I want to hold death at bay* - Lose 20% max HP. When HP drops to 20% or lower, immediately heal back to 100% HP, once per battle. Does not trigger against damage that instantly kills you from above 20% HP.
  - *I desire a flask* - Adds a Flask Charge but lose 10% max HP

#### Libra, Creature of Night Fight Strategy

**The Best Tips for Libra, Creature of Night:**

**Libra Creature of the Night** **(**[Equilibrious Beast](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Equilibrious_Beast "Equilibrious Beast")**)** is a representation of balance, a demonic goat-like [Nightlord](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses") standing on its hind legs. The encounter with **Libra** starts with an interaction between players and the [Scale-bearing Merchant](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Scale-bearing_Merchant "Scale-bearing Merchant"), who will offer players a buff in exchange for a negative effect, such as gaining Stamina while reducing the player's maximum [HP](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Hp "Hp") and [FP](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fp "Fp"). Players may also opt out of the interaction, declining the merchant's offer.

After taking (or not taking) a deal with the merchant, it will transform into the [Equilibrious Beast](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Equilibrious_Beast "Equilibrious Beast"). **Libra** uses its quarterstaff for physical attacks, casts Incantations from the Golden Order, and [Madness](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness")-related spells. The fight with **Libra** will only have one phase, as the boss will not gain anything or become stronger in the latter part of the fight. **Libra** will have the same attack strings, occasionally using quick projectiles to pressure players into playing defensively.

Even if **Libra** utilizes [Madness](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness") for its attacks, it is extremely vulnerable against it. Players can use spells that increase Madness build-up on **Libra**, causing it to enter a frenzied state where it uses its quarterstaff instead of casting its powerful spells. However, due to Madness-related gear being scarce in **Nightreign**, players can also use weapons with [Fire](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fire_Damage "Fire Damage"), [Slash](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Slash_Damage "Slash Damage"), and [Holy](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Holy_Damage "Holy Damage") damage, as **Libra** is also weak against those damage types.

During the fight, **Libra** will only have one phase, so it will use the same attack strings throughout the fight. **Libra** can cast glyphs, similar to Golden Order [Incantations](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Incantations "Incantations"), that can shoot out projectiles from time to time. For example, during the Rain of Light attack, **Libra** will summon a glyph, which then goes to the sky. Light will then appear in the sky, raining down golden projectiles on certain areas.

**Libra** can also create a glyph that repeatedly shoots out light projectiles, which can be avoided easily by strafing sideways, as this does not track players. Sometimes, **Libra** will create glyphs on the ground appearing randomly, which will then erupt after some time. Although these spells can cover a wide area, the visual cues are clear and players can react accordingly to what kind of glyph **Libra** will summon.

**Libra** can also cast spells that are [Madness](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness")-related, such as a cloud raining down flames of frenzy. During this attack, players can watch out for flames protruding in the sky to know where the flames will hit. **Libra** can also cast a wave of lava, which can be evaded by rolling to the side closest to safety.

**Libra** can also cast a spell by hitting the ground with its quarterstaff, generating fog that builds up [Madness](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness") to those affected by it. This spell also creates Madness crystals around the arena which can be collected by players to counter the effect of the fog, needing around six to eight crystals to avoid becoming inflicted with Madness.

The biggest threat in the fight is Libra's meditation, where he enters a crossed-legs pose, begins levitating, and projects a bubble over him. Players have to smash the sigils hovering around him, either by attacking them or running through them, to break his meditation. If his meditation is broken, he goes berserk and starts lunging at the party, usually combo'ing two lunges into a Madness explosion, repeating for two to three cycles before unleashing a torrent of Madness and returning to normal.

If the meditation is not broken and allowed to reach completion, he coats himself in a gold coating and begins using powered-up versions of his usual projectile attacks with greater frequency. Libra will generate more sigils to break for every subsequent time he begins meditating. Breaking his meditation is often far more manageable than the alternative, and it can be done instantly using a Wylder's [Onslaught Stake](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Onslaught_Stake "Onslaught Stake") or a Raider's fully-charged [Retaliate](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Retaliate "Retaliate"). Wide area attacks like the Ironeye's [Single Shot](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Single_Shot "Single Shot") can also break all his sigils at once.

As **Libra** is weak against [Madness](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness"), players can use this to their advantage. If players find any gear or spell that utilizes Madness, which is rare in Nightreign, it can be repeatedly used on **Libra**, affecting it and altering its attacks. Once **Libra** is frenzied, it will stop casting spells, focusing on using its quarterstaff throughout the duration.

When this happens, players should focus on dealing as much damage as possible, as **Libra** will put itself in a vulnerable spot as it blindly attacks with its staff. Its attacks will be more basic, allowing players to retaliate against **Libra**. In the likely chance that no Madness weapons are found, Libra is still vulnerable to Holy and Fire damage, and those types should also be prioritized during the course of the run.

#### Libra Creature of Night Everdark Sovereign (Equilibrious Beast) Fight Strategy

At the start of the encounter, players will be talking to the [Scale-Bearing Merchant](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Scale-bearing_Merchant "Scale-bearing Merchant") again, identical to the base variant of Libra. The Scale-Bearing Merchant will be offering buffs in exchange for a negative effect, or they can refuse the deal to start the fight with **Everdark Libra** immediately. Once the Scale-Bearing Merchant transforms into **Everdark Libra**, the fight will officially begin.

**Everdark Libra** will have the same weaknesses as its normal variant, so it is recommended for players to plan and take routes that would yield them equipment related to **[![madness status effect elden ring wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/0/06/Madness_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png/20px-Madness_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness") [Madness](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness")**. However, it can be quite rare to find related equipment, so players can use [![holy upgrade affinity elden ring wiki guide 60px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/2/23/Holy-upgrade-affinity-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide-85px.png/20px-Holy-upgrade-affinity-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide-85px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Holy_Damage "Holy Damage") [Holy](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Holy_Damage "Holy Damage") or [![poison status effect elden ring wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/3/3a/Poison_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png/20px-Poison_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Poison "Poison") [Poison](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Poison "Poison") equipment alternatively if it is not possible to obtain Madness gear.

#### Phase 1

During the first phase of the fight, **Everdark Libra' *will be using attacks from its normal variant, such as the*** *Lightstorm Glyp'***h**, quarterstaff attacks, and the **Glyph of Madness** that erupts on the ground occasionally. The first phase of **Everdark Libra** will be straightforward, as its attacks will mostly be simple attacks that can be evaded with good positioning and dodge roll timing. There will be plenty of time for players to retaliate, as **Everdark Libra's** attacks allow players to stick close to it for counterattacks.

#### Phase 2

Phase 2 **Everdark Libra** starts when it conjures a glyph and channels madness around it. In this phase, the fight will be more difficult as **Everdark Libra's** attacks will zone out the player, while the boss itself will be mobile. Glyphs will randomly show up around the arena throughout Phase 2, so players should be mindful of their positioning at all times during this fight.

**Everdark'** *Libra **will start to conjure "'*****Condemned**" hostiles, invaders who will attack the player, which can be easily disposed of in a few attacks. **Everdark Libra** will also erratically attack around the battlefield, swinging its quarterstaff and pouncing in random directions. Occasionally, **Everdark Libra** will teleport to a random glyph around the arena, making it difficult for players to stay beside it to attack.

Throughout the fight, **Everdark Libra** will apply persistent debuffs, which will be listed below. As these debuffs will add a layer of difficulty to the fight, players should always be mindful of their position to not get hit by the glyph explosions, avoid building up **[![madness status effect elden ring wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/0/06/Madness_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png/20px-Madness_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness") [Madness](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Madness "Madness")**, and to be aware of the debuff applied by **Everdark Libra**.

Debuffs applied by **Everdark Libra**:

- **Demon's Mirage**: Unable to see your teammates.
- **Demon's Sight**: Will randomly accumulate the madness gauge.
- **Meaningless Trial**: Reduce max HP (50%) or Reduce max FP
- **Demon's Awakening**: Adds a madness effect to the weapon.
- **Blessing of Deception**: Will not consume flasks, but each use will lower your level.
- **Demon's Summon**: Directly summons a Night Invader, may scale with players.
- **Demon's Brawl**: Activate friendly fire during the Libra fight.

**Night of the Demon** is a **[Relic](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Relics "Relics")** in **[Nightreign](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Nightreign_Wiki "Elden Ring Nightreign Wiki")**. Night of the Demon is a unique relic that is acquired by defeating the [Equilibrious Beast](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Libra_Creature_of_Night "Libra Creature of Night") Night Lord for the first time, all [Nightfarers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Nightfarers_(Classes) "Nightfarers (Classes)") can use and slot this relic into red colored vessel slots of the equipped chalice. Relics are permanent rewards earned by [Nightfarers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Nightfarers_(Classes) "Nightfarers (Classes)") after each successful or unsuccessful expedition, these relics randomly generate passive benefits that can apply bonuses or effects to various aspects of a Nightfarer's stats, skills, and combat. Managing Relics can be done by conducting a relic rite via the Relic Rites area in the [Roundtable Hold](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Roundtable_Hold "Roundtable Hold"). Relics used in rites are not consumed and can be repeatedly used in later relic rites. The Relic Rite menu can be accessed directly from the Roundtable Hold menu.

**Fulghor Champion of Nightglow**, also known as **Darkdrift Knight**, is a **[Nightlord](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses")** in **[Nightreign](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Nightreign_Wiki "Elden Ring Nightreign Wiki")**. As with other [Nightlords](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses"), this is one of the challenging Night Bosses players face on the third and final day, equipped with its own unique move set, weaknesses, resistances, skills, and abilities. Defeating it requires players to coordinate their attacks carefully in order to achieve victory. Fulghor Champion of Nightglow is specifically the Nightlord encountered during the [Darkdrift Knight](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Darkdrift_Knight "Darkdrift Knight") expedition.

- [Click here for the Everdark Sovereign variant of Fulghor, Champion of Nightglow](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fulghor_Champion_of_Nightglow_Everdark_Sovereign_(darkdrift_Knight) "Fulghor Champion of Nightglow Everdark Sovereign (darkdrift Knight)")

> An ancient centaur consumed with battle. His fervor for the gods he serves yet burns within, wielding a sacred form of the Night's power. According to legend, the mightily radiant gods were able to conceal themselves in the roar of the thunder.

#### Negations (or Absorptions)

The [negation](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Calculating_Damage "Calculating Damage") numbers are the % of your damage that gets blocked. For example, if a negation is 60, 40% of that damage by that type will go through and 60% will be negated. Bigger number = less damage. A negation of 100 means no damage goes through, and a negation of -100 mean the enemy takes 2x damage from that source. 0 means damage goes pretty much as is.

#### Resistances

The resistance numbers are the buildup amount to trigger it. For example, if a resistance is 100 you must deal 100 points of the given buildup to trigger it. Note that these go down over time, and increase each time the effect procs. The values after the "/"s indicate the increased resistances after each successive proc.

### Elden Ring Nightreign Fulghor Champion of Nightglow Boss Guide

#### Fulghor Champion of Nightglow Boss Video Guide

Boss Guide video coming soon!

#### Fulghor Champion of Nightglow Fight Strategy

**The Best Tips for Fulghor Champion of Nightglow:**

**Fulghor Champion of Nightglow** ([Darkdrift Knight](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Darkdrift_Knight "Darkdrift Knight")) is a centaur-like [Nightlord](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses") that wields a lance in combat. His speed lets him close in on players quickly with his long reach, which makes it genuinely difficult to gauge a safe distance from him during the fight. Most of his attacks in Phase 1 are physical and telegraphed, but Phase 2 introduces new moves that can be tough to dodge, especially for players trying to retreat to heal or reset.

[Scarlet Rot](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Scarlet_Rot "Scarlet Rot") is a great [Status Effect](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Status_Effects "Status Effects") to inflict on Fulghor, since the boss tends to run around the arena a lot, making consistent damage difficult for players who aren't yet familiar with the fight. During the stretches where Fulghor is moving around the battlefield, status effects like Scarlet Rot or [Poison](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Poison "Poison") help keep the party's overall DPS up even when direct hits are hard to land. It's worth having one or two party members dedicate themselves to a specific Status Effect to make sure it actually gets applied. That said, players should keep in mind that repeatedly applying the same status effect will make Fulghor increasingly resistant to it over time.

##### Phase 1

Fulghor gives off a single audio cue before several of his attacks, grunting just before he begins. In the Charging Stomp attack, for instance, he grunts right before leaping into the air, giving players a brief moment to reposition as the attack starts. Most of his attacks come with an area-of-effect component, since his stomps and lance strikes can generate shockwaves or ground fissures. Players are generally safest moving toward Fulghor's back, as his lance is far less likely to reach anyone positioned behind him. Patience matters a lot in this fight too, since several of his attacks recover quickly and can punish players who attack more often than they should.

When Fulghor channels the Golden Lance attack, there's an opportunity to interrupt it by attacking him directly during the cast. Since Fulghor is extremely weak to [![lightning upgrade affinity elden ring nightreign wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/2/2d/Lightning-upgrade-affinity-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide-25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Lightning_Damage "Lightning Damage") [Lightning](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Lightning_Damage "Lightning Damage"), players using Incantations or Weapons infused with Lightning can land heavy attacks to stagger him mid-channel. Even if he still completes the cast, the resulting spell ends up weaker than usual. The Ironeye Nightfarer performs especially well during this sequence, particularly when equipped with a Lightning Bow. Successfully interrupting the cast opens a window for the rest of the party to attack, making the overall encounter notably easier.

##### Phase 2

Once Fulghor's health drops to 50%, his left arm bursts from his body, kicking off the second phase. He leaps into the air and slams the ground with his left arm upon landing. To avoid this, players should jump just as he begins descending, and those standing farther away from him will find it easier to time their roll correctly. Most of his original attack patterns carry over into this phase, but he gains new moves tied to his left arm as well. One such move is a sweeping strike across his left side that releases Poison, and he's able to chain this sweep multiple times in a row, making it hard to dodge and punishing for anyone caught out of position.

Fulghor can also threaten players from a distance by flinging poison out around his body, hitting anyone caught at medium range. This is frequently followed by a ground slam from his left arm, producing a medium-range AoE shockwave around him. Both of these can be avoided with well-timed dodge rolls or mitigated with a shield. Outside of the recurring Golden Lances that continue to erupt from the ground, Fulghor's overall behavior becomes much less predictable in this phase. Staying alert and prioritizing good positioning becomes essential for survival and for finding openings to attack. [![lightning upgrade affinity elden ring nightreign wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/2/2d/Lightning-upgrade-affinity-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide-25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Lightning_Damage "Lightning Damage") [Lightning](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Lightning_Damage "Lightning Damage") damage is still effective in Phase 2, so players are recommended to use Lightning-infused weapons or [Incantations](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Incantations "Incantations") to build-up Stance damage on **Fulghor** and open windows for counterattacks.

#### Elden Ring Nightreign Fulghor Champion of Nightglow Lore, Notes & Other Trivia

- Boss name is most likely derived from Latin word *fulgor* meaning brightness, splendor, glory, or a flash of lightning.
- Fulghor's triple wind slash combo is actually divided in two separate attacks, a double wind slash and a slower single wind slash. Because of this he is able to interrupt the combo after the first two slashes, allowing for a different attack as follow up.
- The Executor's Cursed Sword skill is exquisitely difficult to use well in Fulghor's third phase, for some of his twinblade attacks come from too wide angles to be parried.
- The name Fulghor could also likely come from Fulgurite, the glass that is made when lightning strikes sand.

#### Fulghor Champion of Nightglow Everdark Sovereign (Darkdrift Knight) Fight Strategy

The **Everdark Sovereign' *variant of*** *Fulghor **is a significant step-up compared to the regular version (Fulghor Champion of Nightglow) in terms of difficulty, with the** Everdark Sovereign Fulghor **starting in the second form of the regular version. In** Everdark Sovereign Fulghor's **first form, he will still be using the same attacks from the regular variant, although some will be enhanced.** Everdark Sovereign Fulghor **can erratically use his poison claw to swing in a wide area, sometimes using it to slam onto the ground, affecting a large part of the battlefield with a shockwave. In this form, players must be cautious of the*** **Enhanced Golden Charge*, as it will have an additional attack at the end.*** *Everdark Sovereign Fulghor **will be channeling a spell that generates a blast around him, with the blast radius affecting a large portion of the arena. When** Everdark Sovereign Fulghor''***s** health reaches three fourth to half, his claw will turn into a hand, which will be the second phase of the fight. **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor's** second form will involve more precise attacks, such as him conjuring a bow that quickly shoots an arrow at the player. **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** can also transform his lance into a twinblade, quickly swinging it around him. Players should be careful not to overextend in the second phase, as **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor's** attacks are more lethal. **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** will still be vulnerable to **[![lightning upgrade affinity elden ring wiki guide 60px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/5/57/Lightning-icon-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide.png/20px-Lightning-icon-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Lightning_Damage "Lightning Damage") [Lightning](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Lightning_Damage "Lightning Damage")** and [Status Effects](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Status_Effects "Status Effects"), so players should focus on obtaining those items during their run.

##### Phase 1

At the beginning of the fight, **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** will have his claw, which is the second form of base Fulghor. Players can find the first phase familiar, as **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** will retain some of the attacks from his base form. **Fulghor** will still be using his claw to sweep in a wide area, controlling the pace of the fight. **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** will also be using his lance to swipe or stab players while moving, which can make it difficult for players to retaliate or catch up to the boss. **Fulghor** retains a weakness to lightning damage, as it can interrupt his Golden Lance attack if he is charging it. This is the *only* part of his moveset that is affected by his lightning weakness.

One attack that players should be cautious of when fighting **Fulghor** is the *Enhanced Golden Charge*, which will still play out mostly the same as the base variant's attack, but a follow-up attack is added with **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** channeling a blast that affects a wide area around him. In this phase, sticking to **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** can be quite difficult with him running around the arena, so players will spend the majority of the time in the medium range of **Fulghor**. Counterattacking can be hard due to **Fulghor** being highly mobile, so chipping his health little-by-little is the way to go.

##### Phase 2

When **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor's** health reaches 75% to 50%, he will float in the air, and his claw will turn into an arm. In this phase, **Fulghor** will be using more refined attacks, involving him conjuring a bow or a twinblade. The first thing he always does after the phase change is Rain of Arrows, where he fires an arrow into the sky before one to three series of arrows begin pouring down in his vicinity, moving in the general direction of each player. Avoid being too aggressive during the phase change, lest the arrows chew through your entire HP bar quickly.

From this point on, **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** no longer has his flailing arm, but his twinblade attacks are quite hard to deal with, as he will be using long, swift attack strings that can be hard to judge if the sequence is over. This boss's attacks will be quick, so players need to dodge while positioning themselves at the side or behind **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor** to be able to retaliate. Due to the increased aggression and power of his attacks, players must be cautious not to overextend and should rely on well-timed dodges and positioning to defeat **Everdark Sovereign Fulghor**.

The final and deadliest attack sees **Fulghor** gallop into the sky, targeting one teammate. After he trains his bow on that teammate's location, the point of impact of the attack will instead be marked by a faint golden line. He will then launch a great arrow into that point, which causes a massive explosion a split second afterwards. Teammates should keep their distance from the targeted person, while the targeted person should watch their position and instead begin running the moment the golden line appears. Fulghor drifts backwards down to the ground after launching this attack and has a long recovery animation, creating a window for those who run towards his position while evading the explosion.

**Caligo Miasma of Night**, also known as **Fissure in the Fog**, is a **[Nightlord](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses")** in **[Nightreign](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Nightreign_Wiki "Elden Ring Nightreign Wiki")**. **Caligo** takes the form of a dragon that uses frost and fog to its advantage, attacking relentlessly against players who find themselves lost within its mist. As with other Nightlords,this is a challenging Night Boss faced on the third and final day, bringing its own unique move set, weaknesses, resistances, skills, and abilities to the table. Bringing it down requires players to coordinate their attacks carefully in order to come out victorious. Caligo Miasma of Night is specifically the Nightlord encountered during the [Fissure in the Fog](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fissure_in_The_Fog "Fissure in The Fog") expedition.

#### Negations (or Absorptions)

The [negation](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Calculating_Damage "Calculating Damage") numbers are the % of your damage that gets blocked. For example, if a negation is 60, 40% of that damage by that type will go through and 60% will be negated. Bigger number = less damage. A negation of 100 means no damage goes through, and a negation of -100 mean the enemy takes 2x damage from that source. 0 means damage goes pretty much as is.

#### Resistances

The resistance numbers are the buildup amount to trigger it. For example, if a resistance is 100 you must deal 100 points of the given buildup to trigger it. Note that these go down over time, and increase each time the effect procs. The values after the "/"s indicate the increased resistances after each successive proc.

#### Caligo Miasma of Night Fight Strategy

**The Best Tips for Caligo Miasma of Night:**

**Caligo Miasma of Night** ([Fissure in the Fog](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fissure_in_The_Fog "Fissure in The Fog")) is a massive draconic [Nightlord](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses") covered in sharp spikes, with towering wings and claws for attacking [Nightfarers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Nightfarers "Nightfarers"). Throughout the fight, Caligo relies on its body to attack, sweeping its tail and limbs across the arena, while also calling on Ice and Frost magic to slow players down. Early in the encounter, its attacks are mostly physical and can be dodged with well-timed rolls. Every so often, it breathes frost across the field, both damaging players and leaving behind patches of lingering ice that hinder movement. Once its health drops below a certain point, Caligo summons a thick mist that blocks the players' view and briefly retreats from the fight. As the fog clears, it becomes obvious this was a setup, since Caligo uses the cover to prepare a devastating attack.

##### Phase 1

At the start of the fight, Caligo relies on basic dragon attacks like claw swipes and its frost breath. To keep its attacks easier to read, players are advised to position themselves in front of the boss and target its head whenever the opportunity allows. Since Caligo mostly stays stationary during this phase, players can generally hold their position in front of it, or move underneath it if it begins using variations of its frost breath.

From time to time, Caligo summons fog that blocks the players' line of sight, setting up a devastating attack that comes in two different forms. In the first variant, players will notice a dark wind moving in a particular direction, and following that visual cue leads to a giant ice pillar that can shield them from Caligo's incoming ice blast. The second variant instead announces itself through a sound resembling crackling ice. When players hear this, the correct response is to run away from the direction the sound is coming from, since Caligo is about to summon an ice glyph that crashes down across a massive portion of the battlefield.

##### Phase 2

The second phase sees Caligo become considerably more aggressive. It begins summoning icy vortices across the battlefield and takes to the sky. From the air, it dives toward players while firing ice projectiles from its wings, an attack that can be dodged by rolling toward Caligo's head as it comes down. This phase is marked by much more frequent flying, blending aerial attacks together with its earlier ground-based patterns, a clear shift from the first phase where Caligo stayed grounded throughout. Because it spends so much time airborne, catching up to it becomes difficult, so it's recommended to land at least one hit before it retreats back into the sky in order to keep building up Stance damage. Doing so eventually breaks its poise and opens a window for a proper attack. This second phase runs considerably longer and proves more demanding overall, since closing the distance while still avoiding its attacks isn't easy. Players are better off avoiding overextension and instead chipping away at Caligo's health gradually, since its attacks hit much harder during this stretch of the fight.

#### Caligo Miasma of Night Everdark Sovereign (Fissure in the Fog) Fight Strategy

The **Everdark Sovereign** variant of **Caligo** will use more attacks with ice properties compared to the normal variant, making the boss encounter difficult for players unprepared for the effects of Frostbite damage and buildup. With this, players are highly recommended to obtain the [Favor of the Mountaintop](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Favor_of_The_Mountaintop "Favor of The Mountaintop") from the [Shifting Earth](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Shifting_Earth "Shifting Earth") whenever possible, as this buff will be effective against this boss. Players should also prepare a route that not only includes the Mountaintop, but also locations that contain equipment that deals [![fire upgrade affinity elden ring wiki guide 60px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/e/ef/Fire-upgrade-affinity-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide.png/20px-Fire-upgrade-affinity-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fire_Damage "Fire Damage") [Fire](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fire_Damage "Fire Damage") damage. The fight with **Everdark Sovereign Caligo** involves plenty of preparation before the fight, as players will gain a big advantage before even fighting the boss.

At the start of the fight, **Everdark Sovereign Caligo** will be using similar attacks to its normal variant, such as sending out an **Ice Barrage** towards players, or exhuming a **Freezing Mist** as it sweeps the battlefield. When **Caligo's** health reaches 50%, it will envelop itself in Arctic Armor, signaling the start of the second phase. During the second phase, **Caligo** will be utilizing deadlier attacks, such as an **Ice Bomb** that has a large AoE, and **Ice Shards** that can be fatal to players with bad positioning.

##### Phase 1

The fight with **Everdark Sovereign Caligo** starts with the fog dissipating, revealing **Caligo** flying in the air, readying its **Ice Crash** attack. It will then dive down at the player, with the icicles moving forward at the player. Players can avoid this attack by rolling towards **Caligo** to move past its flight path and to evade all the icicles raining down on them. Once players dodge the initial attack, players should prioritize sticking to melee range of **Everdark Sovereign Caligo**, as most of its attacks will comprise of ranged ice attacks that do not affect players beside **Caligo**. In the first phase, **Everdark Sovereign Caligo** will mostly be stationary, allowing players to attack it until it finishes its long attack sequences. Compared to the first phase of the original fight (See Caligo Miasma of Night), **Caligo** will barely utilize physical attacks, as it will rely on its frost magic.

##### Phase 2

Once **Everdark Sovereign Caligo's** health reaches 50%, it will envelop itself in **Arctic Armor**. To deal with the **Arctic Armor**, it will automatically break after repeatedly attacking the boss. Players can find [![fire upgrade affinity elden ring wiki guide 60px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/e/ef/Fire-upgrade-affinity-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide.png/20px-Fire-upgrade-affinity-elden-ring-nightreign-wiki-guide.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fire_Damage "Fire Damage") [Fire](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fire_Damage "Fire Damage") damage effective for this, as **Caligo** is extremely weak to this damage type. Each part of **Caligo** will be enveloped with armor, so each armor part that break will deal additional damage to it. In this phase, players should be cautious for Frostbite build-up, as **Everdark Caligo's** attacks will slowly build this status effect. **Caligo** will also begin using more lethal attacks, such as conjuring an ice pillar that explodes after a second projectile is fired by **Caligo**, which affects a large area of the battlefield. The second phase of **Everdark Caligo** will consist of zoning attacks, such as **Ice Shards** that punishes players that do not move away from it. For the second phase, players should be mindful of which attacks allow them to stick close to **Caligo**, as there will be less compared to the first phase. **Caligo** will be mobile in this phase, so players will spend a significant time chasing the boss while also being careful of its zoning attacks.

**Dark Night of the Miasma** is a **[Relic](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Relics "Relics")** in **[Nightreign](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Nightreign_Wiki "Elden Ring Nightreign Wiki"),** obtained by defeating [Everdark Caligo](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Caligo_Miasma_of_Night_Everdark_Sovereign_(fissure_in_The_Fog) "Caligo Miasma of Night Everdark Sovereign (fissure in The Fog)") Nightlord. Relics are permanent rewards earned by [Nightfarers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Nightfarers_(classes) "Nightfarers (classes)") after each successful or unsuccessful expedition. This relic has fixed effects that improve physical damage negation, add frost to the starting armament, and conceal the Nightfarer during active frostbite effects. Managing Relics can be done by conducting a relic rite via the Relic Rites area in the [Roundtable Hold](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Roundtable_Hold "Roundtable Hold"). Relics used in rites are not consumed and can be repeatedly used in later relic rites. The Relic Rite menu can be accessed directly from the Roundtable Hold menu.

*The night belonging to Caligo, left upon her defeat.*

*The power of its namesake can be unlocked by performing a relic rite.*

*From the phantasmal peak upon which she hid herself, she peered down into the world, committing to memory what she perceived. Then, her eye drawn to a certain cataclysm, from out of hiding she leapt with wings unfurled.*

*For she wished to know and to understand, first hand, just what fortunes and misfortunes the disaster would bring upon the world.*

- Equipped by: All [Nightfarers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Nightfarers_(classes) "Nightfarers (classes)")
- Can be purchased from the [Collector Signboard](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Collector_Signboard "Collector Signboard") outside the Roundtable Hold for 12 [Sovereign Sigils](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Sovereign_Sigil "Sovereign Sigil").
- Defeat [Everdark Sovereign Caligo](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Caligo_Miasma_of_Night_Everdark_Sovereign_(fissure_in_The_Fog) "Caligo Miasma of Night Everdark Sovereign (fissure in The Fog)") Night Lord for this relic to be added to the shop of the [Collector Signboard](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Collector_Signboard "Collector Signboard").

**Heolstor the Nightlord**, also known as the **Night Aspect**, is a **[Nightlord](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses")** in **[Nightreign](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Nightreign_Wiki "Elden Ring Nightreign Wiki") and** is the origin of [the Night](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/The_Night "The Night") itself. [Nightlords](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses") as a whole are the challenging Night Bosses players face on the third and final day of an expedition, each bringing its own unique move set, weaknesses, resistances, skills, and abilities to the fight. Taking one down requires players to coordinate their attacks closely in order to come out victorious. Heolstor the Nightlord specifically is the boss encountered during the [Night Aspect](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Night_Aspect "Night Aspect") expedition.

### Elden Ring Nightreign Heolstor the Nightlord Boss Guide

#### Heolstor the Nightlord Boss Video Guide

#### Heolstor the Nightlord Fight Strategy

**The Best Tips for Heolstor the Nightlord:**

**Heolstor the Nightlord** ([Night Aspect](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Night_Aspect "Night Aspect")) will first be encountered as **The Shape of Night**, a spectral knight covered in tattered cloth over its purple armor. At first, he will only have one arm wielding a broken greatsword. He usually only does one attack at a time, having very little combo potential. The Shape of Night moves slowly throughout this opening stretch, but once its health drops to around 60%, it draws the greatsword from behind its back and starts putting it to use. From that point on, it gains new attacks, including roars and dash combos, while its earlier attacks start chaining into more combos and follow-ups.

Once **The Shape of Night** is defeated, it will start emitting darkness out of its body, which will then abruptly cut to reveal its true form, **Heolstor the Nightlord** ([Night Aspect](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Night_Aspect "Night Aspect")). In this form, **Heolstor** sheds the tattered cloth covering its armor, and its greatsword ([Dark Moon Greatsword](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Dark+Moon+Greatsword) in [Elden Ring](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden+Ring+Wiki)) is fully imbued. **Heolstor** is considerably stronger here than it was as The Shape of Night, relying on teleportation and its enchanted blade to catch unprepared [Nightfarers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Nightfarers "Nightfarers") off guard. It gains a number of new attacks tied to the imbued greatsword, including AoE attacks and long-range projectiles. Because Heolstor can teleport right next to players who try to keep their distance, simply disengaging from the boss doesn't guarantee safety.

##### The Shape of Night

During this first part of the fight, The Shape of Night moves at a slow pace, relying on telegraphed slashes and dashes that are fairly easy to dodge roll through. Its attacks are simple enough that players just need to watch the movement of its sword to read what's coming next. Still, even though the attacks themselves are straightforward, the boss attacks constantly, so it shouldn't be underestimated. Because its moves are so readable, players can land Guard Counters to open up windows for their own attacks. For anyone who has trouble predicting its attacks well enough to land a Guard Counter, dodge rolling backward works just as well to stay safe.

Once The Shape of Night's health reaches roughly 60%, it starts wielding the greatsword that had been resting on its back, and its behavior shifts noticeably. It becomes far more aggressive, chaining together multiple slashes in quick succession and gaining the ability to dash through long combos that cover a lot of ground. When players notice it dashing toward them, the safer play is to dodge straight into the attack to avoid damage, then keep moving to dodge the slashes that typically follow. Once its health bar is fully depleted, the boss emits black flame from its body, signaling the transition into the next phase of the fight.

##### Heolstor the Nightlord Phase 1

After The Shape of Night's health bar is emptied, the fight cuts abruptly to reveal Heolstor's true form. The tattered cloth is gone, replaced by full armor and the fully enchanted greatsword. This first phase is considerably more aggressive than the previous fight against The Shape of Night, with Heolstor performing longer, faster dashes and swinging its enchanted greatsword far more often. It also recovers from its own attacks more quickly, which makes landing counterattacks noticeably harder. On top of its melee pressure, Heolstor begins using [Incantations](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Incantations "Incantations") and other devastating attacks that can prove fatal if players fail to dodge them in time.

Much of Heolstor's offense in this phase comes from its imbued greatsword, which it uses to launch projectiles or trigger wide AoE explosions that can be tricky to avoid. When Heolstor spins around while dragging its sword along the ground, players should be ready to dodge the magic projectiles that follow each slash. It can also channel a barrage of projectiles all flying toward the player's position, but this leaves it vulnerable to strong attacks. The best response during this channeling attack is to run toward Heolstor while dodging the incoming projectiles, then land a heavy attack to stagger it and cut the spell short.

##### Heolstor the Nightlord Phase 2

Once **Heolstor's** health bar reaches 60%, it will fly into the air, creating a rift in the sky. **Heolstor** will then slam his sword onto the ground, creating explosive fissures with random [Status Effects](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Status_Effects "Status Effects") or [Damage Types](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Damage_Types "Damage Types") depending on the sword's enchantment. To avoid the fissures on the ground, players should run away from the boss to have a greater chance of avoiding the fissures.

Heolstor also closes distance aggressively in this phase, either through fast dash attacks or by teleporting directly next to nearby players, which makes it difficult to find a moment to heal or reset positioning. Overall, this phase ramps up the aggression even further compared to Phase 1, with Heolstor stringing together consecutive slashes before slamming its sword down to unleash a lethal blast around itself. Players who overextend during this stretch of the fight can be overwhelmed quickly by just how relentless Heolstor's attacks become.

#### Elden Ring Nightreign Heolstor the Nightlord Lore, Notes & Other Trivia

- This boss combines all known elemental damage types and most Status Effects, being the most versatile in this regard (similar for the final encounter of Dark Souls III)
- If players have the [Forsaken Hollows](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Forsaken_Hollows "Forsaken Hollows") DLC, **Heolstor** can randomly perform the **Night of the Lord** attack imbued with [![scarlet rot status effect elden ring wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/0/0a/Scarlet_rot_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png/20px-Scarlet_rot_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Scarlet_Rot "Scarlet Rot") [Scarlet Rot](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Scarlet_Rot "Scarlet Rot"), which is the status effect that most of the [Traitorous Straghess's](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Traitorous_Straghess "Traitorous Straghess") is imbued with.
- *Heolstor* is derived from Old English, where it means *darkness*, *obscurity*.

# Remembrance Bosses & Their Tradeable Rewards – Elden Ring (Base Game)

In the base game of *Elden Ring*, **15 bosses** drop **Remembrances** – special Tools that can be traded with **Finger Reader Enia** at the Roundtable Hold for one of two unique rewards, or converted into Runes. Each Remembrance has a fixed Rune value (the amount you receive when trading it in). Below is a complete breakdown of every base‑game Remembrance boss and the two rewards that can be claimed.

*Sources: [Elden Ring Wiki – Remembrance](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance) (lists all 15 base‑game Remembrances and their trade options); [Elden Ring Wiki – Remembrance Bosses](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Remembrance) (confirms the base‑game roster).*

---

- **Total base‑game Remembrances:** 15 (the DLC *Shadow of the Erdtree* adds 10 more, which are excluded here).

- **Rune values of the Remembrance items themselves** range from **20,000 to 50,000**, and each can be exchanged for one of the two rewards listed above (each also valued at the same Rune amount).

**Remembrances** are kept in [New Game+](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/New_Game_Plus "New Game Plus"). There are a total of 15 **Remembrances** in the base game with an additional 10 added with the [Shadow of the Erdtree DLC](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Shadow_of_the_Erdtree "Shadow of the Erdtree").

The [Heart of Bayle](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Heart_of_Bayle "Heart of Bayle") is included because it works in a similar fashion to remembrances. The main difference is that you can't use it for runes nor duplicate it.

### Shadow of the Erdtree Remembrances Gallery

#### [remembrance of the dancing lion remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Dancing_Lion "Remembrance of the Dancing Lion")  [Remembrance of the Dancing Lion](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Dancing_Lion "Remembrance of the Dancing Lion")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of the Dancing Lion, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. When the Impaler's army assailed the tower, the ritual of the lion dance was turned toward martial ends—its divinity, its fury, its light-footed beauty.

#### [remembrance of the twin moon knight remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Twin_Moon_Knight "Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight")  [Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Twin_Moon_Knight "Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Once a Carian princess, Rellana disavowed her birthright and chose to stand at Messmer's side instead, knowing full well that not even the brilliance of the moon could grant him succor. Before long, she became known as the Sword of Messmer.

#### [remembrance of putrescence remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_Putrescence "Remembrance of Putrescence")  [Remembrance of Putrescence](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_Putrescence "Remembrance of Putrescence")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of the Putrescent Knight, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. All tainted flesh eventually becomes putrescence, and this clump of it imbibed St. Trina's nectar, which granted it eternal rest. And so it was that putrescence became her knight.

#### [remembrance of the wild boar rider remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Wild_Boar_Rider "Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider")  [Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Wild_Boar_Rider "Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of Commander Gaius, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Both were as elder brothers to the lion, and both were cursed from birth. In spite of, or perhaps because of this very reason, Gaius was both Messmer's friend and the leader of his men.

#### [remembrance of the shadow sunflower remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Shadow_Sunflower "Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower")  [Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Shadow_Sunflower "Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of the Scadutree Avatar, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Scadutree is the shadow of the Erdtree. Born of dark notions that bear no sense of Order, that twist and bend its stock, rendering it brittle.

#### [remembrance of the impaler remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Impaler "Remembrance of the Impaler")  [Remembrance of the Impaler](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Impaler "Remembrance of the Impaler")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of Messmer the Impaler, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A malevolent snake writhed within Messmer, and so his very mother plucked out his eye and put in its place a seal of grace. Yet, having done so, her fear compelled her to secret away her child within the realm of shadow. Hidden away—keeping company with the original sin, and a hatred that would not be confined.

#### [remembrance of the saint of the bud remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Saint_of_the_Bud "Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud")  [Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Saint_of_the_Bud "Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of Romina, Saint of the Bud, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. After the church was burned to the ground, Romina discovered a twisted divine element, which she weaved into the baleful scarlet rot. Perhaps then, the buds might find somewhere to gain purchase once more, within the scorched remains.

#### [remembrance of the mother of fingers remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Mother_of_Fingers "Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers")  [Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Mother_of_Fingers "Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The mother of all Two Fingers and Fingercreepers was in turn a magnificently gleaming daughter of the Greater Will, and the first shooting star to fall upon the Lands Between.

#### [remembrance of the lord of frenzied flame remembrances elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Lord_of_Frenzied_Flame "Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame")  [Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Lord_of_Frenzied_Flame "Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. As the golden barbs inflicted eternal agony upon him, Midra held fast to Nanaya's entreaty: "Endure." The word was a curse.

#### [heart of bayle key items elden ring shadow of the erdtree dlc wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Heart_of_Bayle "Heart of Bayle")  [Heart of Bayle](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Heart_of_Bayle "Heart of Bayle")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

The biatrial heart of Bayle the Dread. Dotted with horn-like gravel stones and glistening with deep-red liquor. Gorge upon this at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion to absorb Bayle's power. The purest form of Communion, in the words of its priestess. Only one reward may be selected per playthrough.

#### [remembrance of a god and a lord](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_a_God_and_a_Lord "Remembrance of a God and a Lord")  [Remembrance of a God and a Lord](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_a_God_and_a_Lord "Remembrance of a God and a Lord")  [sote new](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Sote-new.png)

Remembrance of Radahn, consort of Miquella, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. In their childhood, Miquella saw in Radahn a lord. His strength, and his kindness, that stood in stark contrast with their afflicted selves. And so Miquella made his heartfelt wish. That Radahn would one day be his king consort.

### Elden Ring Remembrances Gallery

#### [remembrance of grafted elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Grafted "Remembrance of the Grafted")  [Remembrance of the Grafted](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Grafted "Remembrance of the Grafted")[https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Crafting_Kit](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Crafting_Kit "Crafting Kit")

Remembrance of Godrick, the Grafted, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A feeble man sought power through the grotesque act of grafting.  
"One day we'll return together, to our home, bathed in rays of gold."

#### [remembrance of the full moon queen elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Full_Moon_Queen "Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen")  [Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Full_Moon_Queen "Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen")

Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. In her youth, Rennala was prominent champion who charmed the academy with her lunar magic, becoming its master. She also led the Glintstone Knights and established the house of Caria as royalty.

#### [remembrance of the starscourge elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Starscourge "Remembrance of the Starscourge")  [Remembrance of the Starscourge](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Starscourge "Remembrance of the Starscourge")

Remembrance of Starscourge Radahn, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Red Lion General wielded gravitational powers which he learned in Sellia during his younger days. All so he would never have to abandon his beloved but scrawny steed.

#### [remembrance of the regal ancestor elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Regal_Ancestor "Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor")  [Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Regal_Ancestor "Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor")

Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor Spirit, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Ancestral spirits exist as a phenomenon beyond the purview of the Erdtree. Life sprouts from death, as it does from birth. Such is the way of the living.

#### [remembrance of the omen king elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Omen_King "Remembrance of the Omen King")  [Remembrance of the Omen King](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Omen_King "Remembrance of the Omen King")

Remembrance of Morgott, the Omen King, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Though born one of the graceless Omen, Morgott took it upon himself to become the Erdtree's protector. He loved not in return, for he was never loved, but nevertheless, love it he did.

#### [remembrance of the naturalborn elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Naturalborn "Remembrance of the Naturalborn")  [Remembrance of the Naturalborn](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Naturalborn "Remembrance of the Naturalborn")

Remembrance of Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A malformed star born in the flightless void far away. Once destroyed an Eternal City and took away their sky. An falling star of ill omen.

#### [remembrance of the blasphemous elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Blasphemous "Remembrance of the Blasphemous")  [Remembrance of the Blasphemous](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Blasphemous "Remembrance of the Blasphemous")

Remembrance of of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Rykard took the form of a giant serpent that he might devour, grow, and live eternally.  
"I understand. The road of blasphemy is long and perilous. One cannot walk it unprepared to sin."

#### [remembrance of the lichdragon elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Lichdragon "Remembrance of the Lichdragon")  [Remembrance of the Lichdragon](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Lichdragon "Remembrance of the Lichdragon")

Remembrance of Lichdragon Fortissax, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. After Godwyn the Golden became the Prince of Death, the ancient dragon fought long and hard against the Death within its companion. Alas, victory was never achieved and its only reward was corruption.

#### [remembrance of the fire giant elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Fire_Giant "Remembrance of the Fire Giant")  [Remembrance of the Fire Giant](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Fire_Giant "Remembrance of the Fire Giant")

Remembrance of Fire Giant, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Fire Giant is a survivor of the War against the Giants. Upon realizing the flames of their forge would never die, Queen Marika marked him with a curse.  
"O trifling giant, mayest thou tend thy flame for eternity."

#### [remembrance of the blood lord item elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Blood_Lord "Remembrance of the Blood Lord")  [Remembrance of the Blood Lord](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Blood_Lord "Remembrance of the Blood Lord")

Remembrance of Mohg, Lord of Blood, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Wishing to raise Miquella to full godhood, Mohg wished to become his consort, taking the role of monarch. But no matter how much of his bloody bedchamber he tried to share, he received no response from the young Empyrean.

#### [remembrance of the black blade elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Black_Blade "Remembrance of the Black Blade")  [Remembrance of the Black Blade](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Black_Blade "Remembrance of the Black Blade")

Remembrance of Maliketh, the Black Blade, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Maliketh was a shadowbound beast given to his Empyrean. Marika's sole need of her shadow was a vessel to lock away Destined Death. Even then, she betrayed him.

#### [remembrance of the dragonlord item elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Dragonlord "Remembrance of the Dragonlord")  [Remembrance of the Dragonlord](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Dragonlord "Remembrance of the Dragonlord")

Remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Dragonlord whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time is said to have been Elden Lord in the age before the Erdtree. Once his god was fled, the lord continued to await its return.

#### [remembrance of hoarah loux elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_Hoarah_Loux "Remembrance of Hoarah Loux")  [Remembrance of Hoarah Loux](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_Hoarah_Loux "Remembrance of Hoarah Loux")

Remembrance of the warrior Hoarah Loux, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. When Godfrey, first Elden Lord was robbed of his grace, becoming Tarnished, he took with him his kinfolk and left the Lands Between. After the Long March of the Tarnished came to an end, Godfrey divested himself of kingship, becoming a simple warrior once more.

#### [remembrance of the rot goddess elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Rot_Goddess "Remembrance of the Rot Goddess")  [Remembrance of the Rot Goddess](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Rot_Goddess "Remembrance of the Rot Goddess")

Remembrance of Malenia, Goddess of Rot, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Miquella and Malenia are both the children of a single god. As such they are both Empyreans, but suffered afflictions from birth. One was cursed with eternal childhood, and the other harbored rot within.

#### [elden remembrance elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Remembrance "Elden Remembrance")  [Elden Remembrance](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Remembrance "Elden Remembrance")

Remembrance of the Elden Beast, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. It was the vassal beast of the Greater Will and living incarnation of the concept of Order.

| --- | --- |

**Remembrances** are special [Tools](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Tools "Tools") that are obtained upon defeating certain bosses in *[Elden Ring](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Elden_Ring_(game) "Elden Ring (game)")*. They can either be used to obtain a large amount of [runes](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Runes "Runes") or traded with [Finger Reader Enia](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Finger_Reader_Enia "Finger Reader Enia") for exclusive items.

## Remembrance Duplication[]

[Wandering Mausoleums](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Wandering_Mausoleum "Wandering Mausoleum") and [Remembrance Coffins](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Remembrance_Coffin "Remembrance Coffin") can be used once each to duplicate a Remembrance, even if the Remembrance has already been used. Mausoleums with bells can duplicate any remembrance, but the two mausoleums without bells at the [![Sites of Grace](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/ER_Map_Icon_Site_of_Grace.png)](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Sites_of_Grace "Sites of Grace") Mausoleum Compound site of grace can only duplicate a Legend remembrance. Coffins found in the [Shadow of the Erdtree expansion](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Elden_Ring:_Shadow_of_the_Erdtree "Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree") can duplicate any remembrance.
